newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota shares climb to eight-year high.
newsitem.headline: Toyota shares climb to eight-year high.

text.p: Shares in Toyota Motor Corp rallied on Monday morning to their highest level in more than eight years.
At 0028 GMT, the share price was 60 yen higher at 3,040 yen, breaking above its previous high of 3,030 yen marked on July 28, 1988. Volume was 2.155 million shares.
Shares in Honda Motor Co Ltd briefly jumped to 3,180 yen before the midday closing, also surpassing its previous high for this year by 10 yen.
Brokers said shares in the car sector were supported by the recent trend of buying blue-chip issues.
